group.name: Tehnix
group.description: The company Tehnix Ltd. is a leading company in this part of Europe for design, production and servicing of machines and equipment used for the environmental protection. Great production possibilities, constant presence at domestic and foreign market, satisfied customers, innovations - improvement of products, as well as safe and long-lasting product life, are the warranty of the successful operation of the company Tehnix, always a safe and good partner for the solution of your ecological needs.
